leadText: Amy Birnbaum is an American voice actress who worked for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Amy Birnbaum is an American voice actress who worked for the English-language dub of . 

==Biography==
Birnbaum was one of the original voice actors on Pokémon. She mostly played characters of the day until , when she was cast as Max. She voiced the character until the end of the eighth season when 4Kids Entertainment gave up the dubbing and distribution of the series to and TAJ Productions. Kayzie Rogers took over the role of Max, and Birnbaum has not returned to voice any characters on the show since.
